description: We’re creating a space mission design game that mixes strategy, creativity, and exploration. I bring graphic design, technical documentation, and vibe coding to help shape both the concept and presentation. I’m looking for teammates interested in game design, programming, storytelling, UI/UX, art, or space science. Join if you want to build a fun and ambitious space-themed project together.
summary: Orbital Express is a browser-based cargo launch game. By balancing payload, speed, energy, and budget, players discover how engineering decisions affect mission success. It makes space mission trade-offs visual, interactive, and accessible.
details:
Orbital Express turns space mission design into a cargo delivery game, starting with the Moon and aiming toward the wider Solar System. Players balance payload, speed, protection, energy, and budget, then learn from flight outcomes.

Built with Vue, TypeScript, and Three.js, it uses NASA/JPL data in a simplified gravity simulation to make engineering trade-offs visual and accessible.
